units.locator: Article 15.48. Violation of restrictions on funds transfers and acceptance of payments, or of a prohibition on concluding an agreement, established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on state regulation of the organisation and conduct of gambling, on lotteries, and on the activities of foreign persons on the Internet in the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: 1. Violation by a payment agent, a communications operator or a postal operator of a requirement not to accept payments established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on state regulation of the organisation and conduct of gambling, on lotteries, and on the activities of foreign persons on the Internet in the territory of the Russian Federation, or of a prohibition on concluding an agreement, or failure to take measures to terminate an agreement, where such a prohibition or requirement is established by law, —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 15.48

units.locator: Article 15.48. Violation of restrictions on funds transfers and acceptance of payments, or of a prohibition on concluding an agreement, established by the legislation of the Russian Federation on state regulation of the organisation and conduct of gambling, on lotteries, and on the activities of foreign persons on the Internet in the territory of the Russian Federation
units.text: shall entail the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of one hundred thousand to five hundred thousand roubles; and on legal entities, of 25 to 40 per cent of the amount of the payment accepted in favour of a person for whose benefit acceptance of payments is not permitted or with whom the conclusion of an agreement is prohibited, but not less than five million roubles.
